title: In FRRouting (FRR) 8.3 through 10.5.1, bgp_notify_decapsulate_hard_reset() in bgpd/bgp_packet.c does not validate the…
description: A vulnerability in FRRouting (FRR) versions 8.3 through 10.5.1 exists in the bgp_notify_decapsulate_hard_reset() function, which improperly validates the length of the data field in a BGP NOTIFICATION Cease/Hard Reset message. When the data field is exactly one byte, this leads to an out-of-bounds heap read and an assertion failure, causing the bgpd daemon to crash and terminate all BGP sessions, resulting in a denial of service. This issue is fixed in versions 10.0.5, 10.1.5, 10.2.6, 10.3.4, 10.4.3, 10.5.2, and 10.6.0.
